purpose: Physically validate the first complete visual fallback loop: real mapped capture, provider-neutral OCR observations, deterministic target resolution, explicit fallback authorization, public Computer Control left-click delivery, then a fresh independent capture/OCR postcondition that alone can verify semantic success.
requiredClaims: the pre-action path uses the real P1B mapped frame, P2B provider-neutral text-region contract, P3A target resolver and P3B action-policy gate
the P4 product executor accepts only the exact P3B AUTHORIZED READY primary left-click plan
the product executes the action through the external public Computer Control clickPointer API
Computer Control returns CLICK_POSTED with positionVerified true, buttonDelivery POSTED and semanticConsequenceVerified false
CLICK_POSTED is recorded as delivery only and is not treated as semantic success
post-action observation is invoked only after posted delivery
the post-action observation performs a new real mapped display capture and a new local OCR interpretation
the test-owned nonactivating AppKit fixture changes from its pre-action visual text to a distinct post-action visual text only after mouseDown
the original pre-action text is absent and the expected postcondition text is present exactly once in the independent post-action OCR observations
VERIFIED_SUCCESS is returned only after the independent post-action observation satisfies the exact-text postcondition
frame payloads, recognized text and coordinates are not persisted or logged
the test restores the initial pointer position using a separate cleanup-only Computer Control pointer.move when the initial pointer is on the primary display
fixture, pointer position and Computer Control runtime cleanup complete successfully
both product working trees remain clean
nonClaims: CLICK_POSTED alone is not task success
the visual target still does not claim semantic UI identity
macOS Vision is not made a built-in Computer Use dependency
no arbitrary user-content OCR accuracy claim is made
no right-click, drag, wheel or keyboard visual fallback is authorized by this checkpoint
no fuzzy text, object, icon or VLM target resolution is validated
no causal claim is made outside the controlled test-owned fixture and exact postcondition
the cleanup pointer.move is test restoration and is not part of the product action under verification
